description:
Project Overview

AITHYRA, the Research Institute for Biomedical Artificial Intelligence of the Austrian Academy of Sciences in Vienna, invites applications for its International PhD Programme in AI for Biomedicine. The next PhD Programme, together with partners TU Wien, Uni Wien, and Meduni Wien, will start in September 2027.

The programme offers fully funded four-year employment positions at the intersection of machine learning, experimental biology, chemistry, medicine, and laboratory automation.

Research position overview

PhD students at AITHYRA work on transformative research questions in biomedical AI, with access to state-of-the-art facilities and interdisciplinary supervision. The programme welcomes applicants from all nationalities and backgrounds.

Research Areas

  • Machine learning for biomedical data
  • Experimental biology and chemistry
  • Laboratory automation
  • Systems medicine and precision health
  • AI-driven drug discovery

About AITHYRA

AITHYRA is the Research Institute for Biomedical Artificial Intelligence of the Austrian Academy of Sciences in Vienna. It brings together machine learning, experimental biology, chemistry, and medicine to transform human health research.
